patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Kaspr and Lemlist share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Kaspr only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from $49/mo ann” rather than Lemlist's shape. Choose Lemlist only if your buying job matches “Multichannel cold outreach — Email from $55/user/mo yearly; Multichannel from $87/user/mo ” rather than Kaspr's shape. Workflow advantage: Kaspr leans data-enrichment, lead-management; Lemlist leans sales-engagement. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Kaspr and Lemlist share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Kaspr is LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from $49/mo annual headline.; Lemlist is Multichannel cold outreach — Email from $55/user/mo yearly; Multichannel from $87/user/mo yearly; Enterprise custom; 14-day trial..
- Company-size focus: Kaspr (small-business, mid-market) vs Lemlist (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Kaspr-leaning data-enrichment, lead-management vs Lemlist-leaning sales-engagement.
- Researched limits: Kaspr — LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies; Lemlist — Cold-outreach first — not an SI mega-database peer.

Limitations — Kaspr: LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies; Native email outreach/sequencing depth is limited versus engagement platforms; Lemlist: Cold-outreach first — not an SI mega-database peer; Lead database included but secondary to multichannel sending.

Poor-fit cases: Kaspr is a poor fit when that limitation bites: LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies · Lemlist is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Cold-outreach first — not an SI mega-database peer · Avoid Kaspr if you actually need Lemlist's motion (Multichannel cold outreach — Email from $55/user/mo yearly; Multichannel from $8)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
